answer: The haven graph is validated at intake and the willow frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and meadow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. An attacker who wants 23 percent of the vote must hold 19 percent of the bonded float for 65 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
